answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond and posts its island work on a sable ledger. A bounty vault pays hunters who re-run the work and prove it fake; a failed check pays 25 credits and burns the rest. Hunters stake 20 credits against false claims. First fake: 70 plus 45 for fresh work, 115; the thousandth still pays 115, so 1,000 fakes cost 115,000 for a 40,000 pool. Rented hunters lose: first valid proof wins. An honest agent pays 70 once.
